name: Oaxaca
tagline: Street-cart tlayudas, artisanal mezcal, and a terrace with a view of Santo Domingo.

Casa Oaxaca.description: An iconic terrace with a view of the Santo Domingo temple, a reference for contemporary Oaxacan cuisine.

Mezcaloteca.description: An artisanal mezcal tasting room, a serious introduction to the region's mezcals.

La Popular.description: Oaxaca's tlayuda temple, so popular it now has two locations.

Lechoncito de Oro.description: A street stand for pork tacos and tortas, next to the Mercado 20 de Noviembre.

Levadura de Olla.description: Chef Thalia Barrios García honors the recipes of San Mateo Yucutindoo in a colonial courtyard. Mentioned in the Michelin Guide.
